1.explanation:
• DatePicker/DatePicker.mdx and DatePicker/docs/overview.mdx show the public API for DatePicker in v11 (props, usage examples) and highlight that there is no ref prop documented.  
• DatePicker/migrate-to-7.x.md provides historical context on how DatePicker’s internals changed in earlier major versions, useful for comparing ref behavior between v10 and v11.  
• DatePickerInput/DatePickerInput.mdx documents the internal input wrapper used by DatePicker; this is where a ref would normally be forwarded to the actual HTML <input>.  
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx and its overview explain how refs are supported on the base TextInput component. By reading these, you can trace the intended ref path (DatePicker → DatePickerInput → TextInput) and identify where forwardRef needs to be added to restore ref support.
1.bug_scenario: When updating from @carbon/react v10 to v11, attempting to attach a React ref to the DatePicker component no longer works. In v11, DatePicker is implemented as a plain function component without React.forwardRef, so passing a ref to <DatePicker ref={pickerRef} /> triggers the console warning “Function components cannot be given refs… Did you mean to use React.forwardRef()?” and the ref remains undefined. In the example screenshot, you can see the rendered DatePicker (a text input box with a calendar icon) and the red error message in the browser console.
